## Body

Store evidence from 2026-11-09:
- pm-001 (a Copilot seat) closed 229 role:pm-001 requests by hand (`request.closed_by_actor`, quiet). 77 of them had a reply from pm-001 carrying in_reply_to, and none was stamped answered.
- All 77 replies have `<hex>-<seq>` ids, so they came through the pij SHIM (`pij send` CLI to `/v1/shim/send`), not the native tool.
- The native Copilot `pij_send` tool (.copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs `send()`) mints a UUID and has no in_reply_to field at all, so a native reply can never answer a request.
- The shim path: `reply_sender` (needs pane or session caller context; refuses unbound) then `answered_by`, then `role_send::answer_by_reply`. The last only stamps when `request.state == Delivered` and `request.holder == from`.
- Not yet determined: which of these the 77 failed. Check the stored holder (delivery may route to a different seat id), the request state at reply time, and whether `reply_sender` returned None for the Copilot shim caller.
- The 65 `request.answered_by_reply` events that did fire were all route "shim", from Claude and OMP seats bound by pane.
